Small note about the name Grauen Wolke:
If by Grauen Wolke you mean grey cloud, then it would actually be Graue Wolke, not Grauen Wolke. Even if you mean the plural of clouds, it would still be Graue Wolken.

Otherwise an interesting read.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
…so this has been in the works for a few months at least.

Picture belongs to me, as it is my own boy betta, Kylo Renfish. He pouts all day. Even when greeting me at the front of the tank when I get home from work.

Big thanks to everyone who read this in chat! AidenEldritch, SpectralDragon, Roget, WestyDude, AbsentmindedNihilist! Also subtletea but IRL got in the way.

Here are some comments that happened in chat.

+ show block
– hide block

AidenEldritch

“Also note characteristic pout.” ;m;
"As can likely be expected, Akai-no-Ren adores his Lady, tolerates his lord, and will happily bite anyone else." ;w;
"When not accompanying his family on social outings, Akai is often found guarding the household doors, or napping on top of houseplants (or the prone bodies of uninvited guests who have been incapacitated via a bite to the head)." ;;;w;;;

SpectralDragon

*gasp* kylofish has bitten five noblemantids I'm so proud
"Also note characteristic pout." pout noted and approved of. an A+ betta pout
"or the prone bodies of uninvited guests who have been incapacitated via a bite to the head" I'm even more proud of him
he is good murderfish I love
"No table manners, but few mantids have those" have u ever seen a praying mantis plow through a hoard of stinkbugs
"And everyone at Ren-chan's wedding was terrified of the fish when he grew fifteen times in size and consumed the entire waterkin-delicacy section of the banquet table." SO PROD OF MURDERFISH I LOVE

Roget

"Also note characteristic pout." I laughed

As is the norm for my SH articles, I looked up a bunch of things while writing.

  • Strange-looking mantises.
  • Random German words associated with the sky ("Wolke" means "cloud", for example). I decided the cloud scorpionkin would all have German names. Because… I don't really remember. Probably rule of cool.
  • The names of the mantises in the high mantid court come from chapter titles of The Tale of Genji.
  • Aphid colors and behaviors!
  • The mountain mentioned is Mount Tsurugi (Tsurugi-dake, "Sword Mountain"), and according to Wikipedia "is called "the most dangerous mountain" climbable." What better place for a honeymoon with a swordsmith??? They probably spent most of the time picking up souvenirs.
  • All the betta things! Betta fish are amazing, everyone. Also very smart. Can recognize faces. Also bite all the things. Yes, they have teeth.

And here is a picture of a betta yawning because fish yawns are adorable they stretch their mouths out and look like they're puckering up
